crossRefs.note: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.

translations.web: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
translations.bsb: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
translations.kjv: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
translations.asv: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
